title: not used atm
instrument-hint: Modified JamesR SolEx with 1200 grating and custom lenses
display-notes: Strong artefacts, banding, stripes and gradients etc. have been present; gotten somewhat mitigated.
display-notes-1: Their origin: probably the lack of a narrow band filter for this spectral region. A SLOAN/SDSS ugriz z filter was used as an ERF.
display-notes-2: Resulting in strong stray light, inner reflections, combined with the unfavorably steep gradients of
display-notes-3: both that of the Sun over the ~100nm bandpass, and the quickly decreasing CMOS response,
display-notes-4: favoring the more energetic photons from the stray light.
